description: Index of the Divine Discourses export tables: static files, read-only, no key. Every number regenerates from the public repository's data and scripts.

license.name: GPL-3.0-or-later
license.note: The tables derive from the Leeds Quranic Arabic Corpus v0.4 (GPL). Keep data/exports/NOTICE-LEEDS.txt with any copy.

tables.name: root-frequencies
tables.description: Every one of the 1,642 roots: raw occurrence count, overall normalized frequency, and per-period count and normalized frequency.
tables.verification: totalCount and normalizedFrequencyOverall: Verified (direct computation). Per-period fields: Nuanced (depend on the four-period chronology named in _chronologySource).

tables.name: association-pairs
tables.description: Root-pair association statistics: the union of every pair appearing in any root's top-25-by-LLR partner list, deduplicated by unordered pair.
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from Leeds morphology, cross-checked against a hand-computed 2x2 table and against data/cooccurrence/*.json's independently computed counts.

tables.name: association-extended
tables.description: Four further root-pair association measures (logDice, t-score, log odds ratio with a 95% interval, directional deltaP) for exactly the pairs in association-pairs, in the same order and orientation.
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from published counts by scripts/lib/association-measures.mjs, hand-computed unit test in scripts/association-measures.test.mjs. Which measure to prefer for a given question is method-dependent.

tables.name: surah-distance
tables.description: Jensen-Shannon distance between the root distributions of every pair of surahs (6,441 pairs), with a permutation null so each distance can be read against what chance and surah length alone produce.
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from Leeds morphology by scripts/compute-surah-distance.mjs, hand-computed unit test in scripts/surah-distance.test.mjs. Which pairs count as 'distant' depends on the null chosen; this one holds verse boundaries fixed.

tables.name: surah-stats
tables.description: Per-surah corpus fingerprint: all 114 surahs.
tables.verification: verseCount/tokenCount/distinctRootCount/diversity ratios/nounPct/verbPct: Verified (direct computation). formMATTR/formMTLD: Verified (direct computation; formulas hand-verified against fixed-point fixtures). revelationOrder/period: Nuanced (Cairo 1924 / Nöldeke-Bell chronology, one scheme among several).

tables.name: verse-lengths
tables.description: Every verse in the corpus (6,236 rows) with its token length and revelation period.
tables.verification: surah/verse/tokens: Verified (direct tally). period: Nuanced (Cairo 1924 / Nöldeke-Bell chronology).

tables.name: formulas
tables.description: Every recurring 3-5 word sequence in the Qur'an (18,408 rows: 6,403 root-view + 12,005 surface-view), with its first occurrence.
tables.verification: Verified (direct computation from Leeds morphology).

tables.name: centrality
tables.description: Network centrality for all 1,642 roots over the root co-occurrence graph (5,211 edges, built from each root's top-25-by-LLR partners).
tables.verification: Nuanced: the four measures rank roots differently by design, and the graph itself is a subset (each root's top-25 partners, not every pair meeting the underlying 5-shared-verse threshold).

tables.name: rhyme-summary
tables.description: Per-surah roll-up of verse-ending (rhyme) patterns for all 114 surahs.
tables.verification: Verified (direct computation from Leeds morphology and the Tanzil Uthmani text).

tables.name: fawatih
tables.description: The 29 surahs opening with a sequence of isolated letters (fawatih / al-muqatta'at), and which combination.
tables.verification: Verified (direct detection from Leeds morphology). The letters' meaning is not asserted; the classical tradition has never settled it.

tables.name: discursive-pivots
tables.description: 137 verses mechanically flagged for opening with a temporal particle (idh or idha) while sharing a content root with the immediately preceding verse.
tables.verification: Nuanced: depends on the fixed marker list and content-root stoplist; a different choice of either would change the count.

tables.name: structure
tables.description: Mechanically segmented sections for all 114 surahs (TextTiling-derived changepoint detection over lexical cohesion), not a transcribed scholarly outline.
tables.verification: Nuanced: a computed segmentation, not a scholar's reading; never attributed to any named scholar. See docs/maintainer-guide.md on the named-scholar outline policy.

tables.name: structure-tests
tables.description: Four block-level mirror-symmetry tests (concentric pairing, inclusio, formula bookending, verse-length symmetry) over the computed sections in the structure table, one row per surah.
tables.verification: Nuanced: a null result describes this specific mechanical test over a computed segmentation, not the scholarly literature on ring composition, which this site never asserts an outline from.

tables.name: theme-surah-density
tables.description: Sparse theme-by-surah matrix: for each surah, the themes whose root-family vocabulary clusters most densely in it.
tables.verification: Nuanced: perThousand is a direct computation, but which roots belong to which theme is an editorial classification, not a computed fact.

tables.name: formulaic-density
tables.description: Per-surah mean share of words covered by a recurring 3-5-word phrase (Bannister's oral-formulaic density), tested against a length-matched null, for all 114 surahs.
tables.verification: Nuanced: the significance test's null (uniform resampling across the whole corpus) does not control for genre or period, only length.

tables.name: dispersion
tables.description: How evenly each of the 1,642 roots is spread across the 114 surahs, weighted by surah token count.
tables.verification: Nuanced: dp/dpNorm and juillandD are independent formulas that can and do disagree; this site reports both rather than picking one as authoritative.

tables.name: root-surah-counts
tables.description: How often each root occurs in each surah it appears in, as a count and as a rate per 1,000 of that surah's tokens (long format: one row per root per surah).
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from Leeds morphology; per-root sums equal root-frequencies totalCount, and per-root row counts equal dispersion surahsOccurringIn.

tables.name: lemma-frequencies
tables.description: Every lemma (dictionary headword) in the corpus: how often it occurs, its part of speech, its root if it has one, how many distinct written forms it takes, and how widely it is spread.
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from Leeds morphology; row count equals the lemma total on Numbers, and each rooted lemma's count matches data/root-analytics/.

tables.name: verse-durations
tables.description: Every verse with its length in word-units and how long its recitation lasts in each recording the Read page plays, one column per reciter.
tables.verification: Verified as measurements of those files. Nuanced as analysis: a duration is one recording's performance, not a property of the text, and verse-1 files may include the basmala.

tables.name: direct-address
tables.description: Every verse containing the believers' vocative ya ayyuha al-ladhina amanu ('O you who believe').
tables.verification: Verified: direct computation from Leeds morphology. Other vocatives (for example 'O people', 'O Prophet') are not in this table.
